summary: The document contains a server-side script written in VBScript designed to handle login screen functionality in a web application. It includes session management settings and a virtual include directive.
purpose: To manage the login screen of a web application using server-side scripting.

workflows.name: Login Screen Initialization
steps: Set the language to VBScript and disable session state.
Specify script options for explicit variable declaration and buffer output.
Set up screen name variable for the login process.
Include external script for screen handling.

system_behavior: The script sets the screen name for identifying the login screen.
Buffers the server response and sets the page to not cache.
dependencies: The script depends on the external "DoScreen.asp" script for additional functionality.
